newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy drops to day's lows late on fund selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy drops to day's lows late on fund selling.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures dropped to session lows in late trading on fund selling, traders said.
"It looks like maybe Prudential selling and at least two milion bushels," a trader said.
The market already had been weakened by spillover pressure from Friday's bearish USDA crop production report. "There's more fund liquidation," a trader said.
At 1300 CDT, soybeans were three to 18-1/4 cents lower, with November down 18-1/4 at $6.82 a bushel.
